insights: The design system uses a sophisticated layered hover interaction pattern where card content (title, description, CTA) reveals with staggered translate-y animations while background media scales up, creating depth and engagement.
Pill-shaped buttons (rounded-full) dominate CTAs while system UI elements use rounded-lg (10px), establishing clear visual hierarchy between marketing actions and application controls.
Custom easing curves like genius-soft-bounce with 100+ keyframes demonstrate investment in micro-interaction polish, particularly for hover lift effects with coordinated shadow transitions.
